def create_observation(root_cause, details=None):
    os.makedirs("lessons/observations", exist_ok=True)
    # simple implementation for now
    data = {"root_cause": root_cause, "details": details or {}}
    filepath = f"lessons/observations/obs_{int(os.path.getmtime('tools/lesson_manager.py') if os.path.exists('tools/lesson_manager.py') else 0)}.json"

        json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
    return filepath
